newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grain little changed and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grain little changed and quiet.

text.p: UK cash grains were little changed on Tuesday despite sharply lower futures.
"The cash market didn't really follow the futures on Monday so there is no reason for it to come down," said one broker.
Brokers said Monday's rise on the futures market appears to have been overdone and some correction is due.
Brokers also pointed to a report late on Monday afternoon forecasting rain in May.
There were no quotes on the fob market and delivered business was very thin.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was trading at 99 stg for Apr and 106 and 105.50 stg for Jul while in Liverpool 100 stg was paid for Apr.
Old crop feed barley was trading around 95.50 stg for Apr in west Norfolk and 97 and 96.50 stg in Norfolk/Suffolk.
